answer: A harbor admits ships only after each one ties up at a jetty and posts a bond of 40 credits, held for 3 epochs. A sparrow-sized fake fleet of 500 ghosts would need 20000 locked credits, so splitting identities stops being free. Peers verify the bond on-ledger and spot-check each newcomer with a karst-style hard puzzle seeded from the previous block. A ghost caught copying answers loses the bond and is ejected.
